issue:
Impossible to use validators in a way that passes Pyright 1.1.344 validation.
### Initial Checks

- [X] I confirm that I'm using Pydantic V2

### Description

I wanted to raise awareness of [this issue](https://github.com/microsoft/pyright/issues/6875) here.

Currently, Eric is suggesting that defining the Protocols that do the typing for the decorators should be changed from `(self, cls, __value...` to `(self, __cls, __value...`.  However, the [conversation in the typing forum](https://discuss.python.org/t/ambiguities-about-positional-only-parameters/42328) also pointed out that the __ syntax for position-only parameters is only needed for py3.7 or earlier, and since 3.7 is EOL perhaps it makes sense to change to `(self, cls, value, /)`?
